sources.title: Kenya Citizenship and Immigration (Amendment) Rules, 2025 (Legal Notice 93)
sources.officialityEvidence: The Kenya Gazette Supplement identifies Legal Notice 93 and states it was printed and published by the Government Printer, Nairobi.
sources.supportingExcerpt: St. Kitts and Navis is listed among nationals exempt from obtaining eTA for up to ninety days.

sources.title: Kenya eTA: Exempt from eTA
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration Services, State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies the Ministry of Interior and National Administration's Directorate of Immigration Services as operator.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All foreign visitors except citizens of EAC member States must submit Immigration forms.

unresolved.reason: Not established: the governing 2025 schedule identifies 'St. Kitts and Navis', not the current Saint Kitts and Nevis ordinary-passport issuer. The eTA portal does not cure that exact-name ambiguity.
